proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6835 *dhūḍi/dhūli gives dhūr/dhūl/dhulo dust, northern duṛi and discusses variation dh/t. These simple dust responses preserve that family with the source aspiration and retroflex details retained. Reviewed comparison: Bhilali dɦuḷā “dust” (f_ixixtyl6wonfo). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.
